text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the twenty first century it is thought to be difficult to define art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It does not always exist in a gallery.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is not always a solid object or a flat image.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It can be imagined, an action, a pledge, existing only temporarily, it can be made by one people or many, it can be an idea which accumulates over time.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It can exist in other realities and will exist in realities of which we do not yet know.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is thought not to be the servant of the state, of religion or of ritual, but to exist purely for its own sake.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This subjective freedom is highly valued and often disputed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The one constant is that art is made by artists and that it is made for its own sake.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It was not always this way.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE STORY OF ART

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The story of art is the story of the human urge to represent the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This began before humans had acquired verbal language with the simple drawing of a line in the sand with a finger.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In 6000 BC the indigenous groups of prehistoric humans in the continents of Europe, Africa and Asia, the Middle East, the Far East, Australasia and the Americas had not developed any forms of verbal or visual communication.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There was no form of representation in the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: But as these peoples evolved and began to acquire language, conceptual and cognitive skills, they began to create tools.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The first tool may have been a stick used to draw in the sand, or it may have been a stone used to crack a nut or to kill an animal.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: PREHISTORIC ART

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Tools and visual representations are the first evidence we have of the existence of early civilisations.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The earliest examples of these have been found in Africa, the home of the Neanderthals from whom all humans are descended.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Prehistoric people were developing forms of representation before the discovery of fire.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: We know this because some of their drawings and tools have survived.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Art, or the evidence of people’s urge to record their life, is the oldest surviving evidence of human endeavour.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It may be the case that music, probably in the form of rhythm, is an older form of human expression but only drawing, artefacts and objects have permanence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This is why they are assigned such great value in western culture where linear history is the primary means of self definition.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Many other cultures do not place the same emphasis on history.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Their artefacts and art are different.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the beginning art may have been pure representation.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: We do not know whether there was a purpose to art other than pure self expression because there are many examples of prehistoric art whose purpose is unknown to us.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There are lines drawn in the desert in South America that form geometric patterns visible only from the air, patterns scratched and carved into rock, and the countless temporary forms of expression that have been washed or blown away.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE STONE AGE

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: As humans evolved, their visual representations became part of the rituals they created around the most important aspects of life, fertility, birth, death and the hunting for food.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Art began to have a specific function.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The earliest surviving images are scratched into stone, and consist mostly of lines, for example the cave paintings at Lascaux in France.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These and others like them depict people hunting animals, in the case of Lascaux a buffalo like creature.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The paintings are drawn in outline on the wall using paints made of earth and soot based pigments, in ochre, reddish brown and black.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: There are groups of lines too which are unexplained but seem to function as a way of counting or as a visual dynamic.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: As prehistoric people developed more sophisticated tools, they discovered a greater variety of ways of making marks.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Flints could be chipped to make sharp blades with which to cut animal skin, animal hair, and to pulverise plants, earth and clay.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The discovery of fire meant that substances for drawing, painting and modelling could be dried, heated, reduced, distilled and fire provided soot, ash, charcoal and light.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE IRON AGE

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Iron age people had a much greater range of tools and implements.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They had begun to fashion utensils and to make personal adornments from metal, as well as tools and weapons and with these came the development of decoration.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Objects began to have greater value and the degree and type of their decoration began to be significant.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: At the same time Iron Age people also began to acquire language.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One of the first groups to produce metal vessels for eating and drinking was the Beaker people.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Often these objects were decorated with images of animals, vitally important as a source of food.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: ABORIGINAL ART

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In Australasia, the aboriginal people developed an entirely different form of representation.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Early aboriginal art was a language of symbolic representation in which pattern and symbol is used to represent the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Drawings were made using different colours of sand and earth straight onto the ground.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These described the land and its spirits, and depicted time as a journey.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The drawings were temporary and not always shown to everybody, sometimes even being made in isolation.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Different cultures developed different views of the world according to their geographical location, the climate and the food that was available to them.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the Iron Age people from other continents developed along different paths leading to a material expression of cultural difference.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: THE BRONZE AGE

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The smelting of metals led to the discovery of a range of alloys, the first being bronze.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: These metals could be fashioned more intricately and finely allowing for greater precision and decorative effect such as repeating patterns, beaten metal and thin wire.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: EARLY CIVILISATIONS

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The earliest civilisations were formed as people began to travel further in search of food and hospitable land and to encounter other groups both aggressively and peaceably.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Humans had previously been nomadic but some groups began to make permanent settlements and with these came buildings and monuments.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Cave painting and rock carving had been the only permanent sites for art until the construction of permanent dwellings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Settlement gave rise to the construction of stone buildings, burial chambers and monuments all of which could be decorated or contain representation.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: For nomadic people portability had been a factor but now larger and heavier objects were produced and people began to make figurative sculptural representations from stone, clay and wood.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Stonehenge, the great stone circle in Britain which was built in the Stone Age to celebrate the solstice, is a construction which is not decorated but is not a dwelling.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is an early church.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Subsequently buildings that were the focus for ritual whether pagan or religious became the most highly decorated anywhere.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Art and architecture began to be closely linked.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: After the Bronze Age the great early civilisations of the world developed in isolation, reaching their peaks in terms of population, claims to territory and cultural attainment at different periods in history.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pre Columbian art

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The pre Columbian people in south America made some of the most sophisticated early sculpture.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Their stone male and female figures have distinctive flattened and squared forms, with large featured faces.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Later in South America the Mayan Aztec and Inca civilisations became very skilful in the use of gold.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In Africa, the Sumerians and Abyssinians and many other cultures developed widely different forms of visual expression, both in the adornment of the body and dwellings, and in the production of artefacts.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: TRIBAL ART

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In all the continents of the world large numbers of people continued to live as tribes, some settled and some nomadic, rarely coming into contact with other peoples and each with its own cultural specificity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Native Americans, semi nomadic peoples who lived off the plains of America, used leather, beads, feathers and wood, and are today customarily symbolised by the Totem Pole, a ritual sculpture.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Melanesian and Polynesian peoples that depended on the sea for their livelihood used wood, shells and pounded tree bark to make the tapa cloth which they printed with symbolic designs.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Their boats were adorned with the work of their most skilled artists.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Inuit who inhabited the frozen north of America carved from soft stone.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The African subcontinent yielded the largest number of distinct tribes, for example the Nuba, Yoruba, Dogon, Masai and Zulu.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Africa was one of the culturally richest parts of the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: EMPIRES

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The earliest civilisations soon built cities and with cities came armies and battles for territory.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Soon empires were formed, the earliest being the Byzantine, Ottoman, the Roman empire, the Japanese and Chinese empires which were ruled by successive dynasties.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Greece is often referred to as the cradle of civilisation and early Greek culture was the most sophisticated in the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The development of religions was very significant in terms of the history of art was religion became the focus of a large proportion of artistic activity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: ART AND RELIGION

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Religions divided the world and generated an unprecedented quantity of visual art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Many parts of the world remained pagan, worshipping local gods with their own iconography and ritual.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Greeks, for example, had a complex family of pagan gods and myths.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Larger religions began to spread: in the east, Islam, the religion of the Ottoman empire predominated, and in the middle east Christianity.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In Asia Hinduism and Islam co existed although not necessarily in harmony and in China and Japan Buddhism and Taoism were predominant.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Many Northern Europeans such as the Celts, Norse and the Vikings, were pagans.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A burial ship found at Sutton Hoo in Britain contained many examples of Viking art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The ancient Egyptians had their own gods.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Art had been an important part of ritual.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It now became a servant of the state and of religion and in the process the works that have become known as some of the greatest works of art were created.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artists became the producers of religious iconography but of course in Islamic areas no figurative representation appeared anywhere since Islam does not permit it.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: EARLY WRITTEN TEXT

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Writing is a very important influence on art during the period leading up to the birth of Christ and afterward.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: It is thought that writing was developed by the Sumerians and that Sanskrit may be the oldest written language.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The earliest surviving artefacts are the Dead Sea scrolls, written in Sanskrit on papyrus, and the Rosetta stone, an inscribed tablet.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Writing was a new way of describing and recording the world which had previously been exclusively visual and for centuries writing was a skill learned only by the very few.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Visual imagery remained the primary means of communicating and recording events, but as writing began to tip the balance, art was led to fulfil new functions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.3; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.508

g.text:soa: EGYPTIAN ART

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The ancient Egyptians developed an early writing system called hieroglyphics.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They were a wealthy trading civilisation with a highly sophisticated system of government and constructed some of the greatest buildings and monuments ever made, the Pyramids, the Sphinx and the statues of the pharaohs in the Valley of the Kings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The Egyptians worshipped deities such as Isis and Osiris and held cats, certain birds and scarab beetles to be sacred.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Egyptian art is seen at is most spectacular in the tombs of the pharaohs.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They believed in the afterlife, therefore the art that has been found in Egyptian tombs is a good indicator of the life of the living.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Egyptian artists were skilled in carving, casting and gold and silver smithing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They had a style of drawing that is very distinctive – all figures are shown with their body facing forward and the head in profile.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Hieroglyphs use this style too in the creation of long vertically written texts consisting of pictograms.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Egyptian two dimensional art emphasises flatness and uses no perspective but in contrast Egyptian sculpture is very realistic.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A cat has been found carved from black stone and wearing a jewelled collar, for example, and countless sarcophagi for mummified pharaohs bare lifelike effigies.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The sphinxes and the pharaohs carved on a monumental scale, forty metres high, are in proportion and physiologically accurate.
